admission.justification: The authoring, legacy scan and citation count routes use the same memory-relative namespace so hidden cards remain visible to all three consumers.

applicability: Bulk converted-card authoring, legacy-card scanning and the citation-fix document-count fallback.
conditions: Each route enumerates eligible Markdown paths below onboarding/ and filters using the path relative to the memory root.
exclusions: Explicit citation selections or a supplied scanned-document count take precedence over fallback enumeration.
The existing legacy marker and read-failure rules still apply.
statement: Bulk card discovery and counts use memory-relative paths under onboarding.
